name: ecommerce-social-commerce-filament
description: The social shops desk: shops on social networks, the items each network is believed to hold, the status it reports back, and the queue of items it must stop holding.
features: A withdrawal queue counts every item a network is believed to hold and must not, across every shop the merchant has
The queue is swept by one published withdrawal per row, and a sweep that sent nothing never reports as one that worked
A re-read reports four outcomes apart: it answered about all of them, about some, about none because there were none, or it could not be asked at all
A re-read that could not happen is never green and never counted as zero updates
The secret is entered and never read back: no screen, no column and no infolist entry reaches it
Connecting a shop is a named action calling the domain, so Filament's own create and edit machinery is closed on every resource
The network is typed as a validated slug, because the domain ships no network enum and a new network is a new adapter
No listing is deletable from this panel, because deleting the record would leave the item live on the network and unrecorded
An unrecognised remote status is rendered as unrecognised, never as still uploading
A price with no stored currency renders as nothing, and a stock flag never sent renders as nothing rather than out of stock
No title, description, image or link is shown, because the domain stores no copy of the content it sent
Republication is not offered, for the same reason: this panel has no content to re-send and will not invent any
Every screen states its merchant, and a reference belonging to another merchant is not found
Every unpublished Filament ability is forced closed by name, per resource and per relation manager
